content: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
explanation: elephant 以元音音素开头，用 an。
zh: 我在动物园看到一头大象。

content: She is ___ teacher.
explanation: teacher 以辅音音素开头，用 a。
zh: 她是一名老师。

content: ___ sun rises in the east.
explanation: 世界上独一无二的事物前用 the。
zh: 太阳从东边升起。

content: I go to ___ school by bus.
explanation: go to school 表示去上学这一活动，不加冠词。
zh: 我坐公交车上学。

content: He plays ___ piano very well.
explanation: 演奏乐器前用 the。
zh: 他钢琴弹得很好。

content: I like ___ music.
explanation: 泛指的音乐（不可数）不加冠词。
zh: 我喜欢音乐。

content: There is ___ apple on the table.
explanation: apple 以元音音素开头。
zh: 桌上有一个苹果。

content: ___ cat is sleeping on the sofa.
explanation: 特指那只猫，用 the。
zh: 那只猫在沙发上睡觉。

content: We have ___ breakfast at seven.
explanation: 三餐前一般不加冠词。
zh: 我们七点吃早饭。

content: She goes to ___ bed at ten.
explanation: go to bed 是固定说法，不加冠词。
zh: 她十点上床睡觉。

content: He is ___ honest man.
explanation: honest 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，用 an。
zh: 他是个诚实的人。

content: It took me ___ hour to finish.
explanation: hour 的 h 不发音，用 an。
zh: 我花了一个小时完成。

content: This is ___ best book I've read.
explanation: 最高级前用 the。
zh: 这是我读过最好的书。

content: ___ rich should help the poor.
explanation: the + 形容词表示一类人。
zh: 富人应该帮助穷人。

content: I've never seen ___ such beautiful place.
explanation: such + 形容词 + 不可数或复数名词时不加冠词；此处 place 为可数单数，such a beautiful place 更常见，故选不加冠词形式。
zh: 我从没见过这么美的地方。

content: She is ___ only child in the family.
explanation: only 前用 the。
zh: 她是家里唯一的孩子。

content: He was elected ___ president.
explanation: 表示独一无二的职位作表语时不加冠词。
zh: 他当选为总统。

content: We went to ___ Great Wall last summer.
explanation: 专有名词中的建筑物名常用 the。
zh: 去年夏天我们去了长城。

content: ___ Mount Everest is the highest peak.
explanation: 山峰名前一般不加冠词。
zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是最高的山峰。

content: I need ___ new pair of shoes.
explanation: a pair of 是固定量词结构。
zh: 我需要一双新鞋。

content: He plays ___ violin in an orchestra.
explanation: 演奏乐器前用 the。
zh: 他在乐团里拉小提琴。

content: ___ life would be boring without challenges.
explanation: 泛指的人生/生活不加冠词。
zh: 没有挑战的人生会很无聊。

content: She was ___ first to arrive.
explanation: 序数词前用 the。
zh: 她是第一个到的。

content: They live in ___ Netherlands.
explanation: 部分国家名（如 Netherlands、Philippines）前用 the。
zh: 他们住在荷兰。

content: I have ___ headache.
explanation: 表示病痛常用 a + 名词。
zh: 我头疼。

content: He goes to ___ work by train.
explanation: go to work 是固定说法。
zh: 他坐火车去上班。

content: ___ information you gave me was useful.
explanation: 特指你给我的那些信息，用 the。
zh: 你给我的信息很有用。

content: This is ___ unique opportunity.
explanation: unique 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。
zh: 这是一个独特的机会。

content: ___ unemployment has risen sharply.
explanation: 抽象名词泛指时不加冠词。
zh: 失业率大幅上升。

content: He is ___ university student.
explanation: university 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。
zh: 他是一名大学生。

content: ___ Alps are in Europe.
explanation: 山脉名前用 the。
zh: 阿尔卑斯山脉在欧洲。

content: I've been to ___ Japan twice.
explanation: 大多数国名前不加冠词。
zh: 我去过日本两次。

content: She plays ___ basketball every weekend.
explanation: 球类运动前不加冠词。
zh: 她每个周末打篮球。

content: ___ more you practise, the better you get.
explanation: the more... the better... 是固定结构。
zh: 练得越多，你就越好。

content: He was ___ first person to complain.
explanation: 序数词 first 前用 the。
zh: 他是第一个抱怨的人。

content: This book is ___ than that one.
explanation: 多音节形容词的比较级用 more + 原级。
zh: 这本书比那本有趣。

content: He runs ___ than I do.
explanation: 单音节副词的比较级加 -er。
zh: 他跑得比我快。

content: This is the ___ film of the year.
explanation: good 的最高级是 best。
zh: 这是年度最佳影片。

content: She is as ___ as her mother.
explanation: as... as 之间用原级。
zh: 她和她妈妈一样高。

content: The weather is ___ than yesterday.
explanation: bad 的比较级是 worse。
zh: 天气比昨天差。

content: My phone is ___ than yours.
explanation: 多音节形容词用 more 构成比较级。
zh: 我的手机比你的贵。

content: She is not ___ clever as her brother.
explanation: 否定比较用 not so... as。
zh: 她不如她哥哥聪明。

content: This is ___ easiest question.
explanation: 最高级前用 the。
zh: 这是最容易的问题。

content: He is ___ older than his wife.
explanation: much 修饰比较级，表示程度。
zh: 他比他妻子大得多。

content: The queue was ___ than we thought.
explanation: 单音节形容词比较级加 -er。
zh: 队伍比我们想的要长。

content: The more you read, ___ you learn.
explanation: the more... the more... 是固定结构。
zh: 读得越多，学到的越多。

content: This problem is ___ more difficult than it seems.
explanation: much 修饰比较级。
zh: 这个问题比看起来难得多。

content: He is ___ of the two brothers.
explanation: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。
zh: 他是两兄弟中较高的那个。

content: She is ___ than she looks.
explanation: than 前用比较级。
zh: 她比看起来年龄大。

content: This is by far ___ best option.
explanation: 最高级前用 the，by far 加强语气。
zh: 这显然是最好的选择。

content: The earlier you book, ___ the price.
explanation: the + 比较级... the + 比较级 表示同步变化。
zh: 订得越早，价格越低。

content: He works ___ than anyone else.
explanation: hard 的比较级是 harder。
zh: 他比任何人都努力。

content: This is ___ more useful than that.
explanation: far 可修饰比较级，表示程度大。
zh: 这个比那个有用得多。

content: My results were no ___ than last time.
explanation: no better than 意为「不比……好」。
zh: 我的成绩不比上次好。

content: She speaks ___ fluently than her teacher.
explanation: 多音节副词的比较级用 more。
zh: 她说得比她的老师更流利。

content: The test was ___ easier than expected.
explanation: a lot 可修饰比较级，表示程度。
zh: 这次测试比预期容易得多。

content: This is the ___ important issue we face.
explanation: 多音节形容词的最高级用 most。
zh: 这是我们面临的最重要的问题。

content: He is ___ less experienced than his colleague.
explanation: much 修饰 less + 形容词的比较结构。
zh: 他的经验比他同事少得多。

content: The data is far ___ reliable than the earlier sample.
explanation: far 修饰比较级 more reliable。
zh: 这些数据比早先的样本可靠得多。

content: Nothing is ___ than a good night's sleep.
explanation: 否定词 + 比较级表示最高级含义。
zh: 没有什么比睡个好觉更好的了。

content: She is ___ more capable than her predecessor.
explanation: significantly 修饰比较级，表示程度显著。
zh: 她比前任能干得多。

content: The second proposal is ___ preferable to the first.
explanation: far 修饰 preferable 表示程度。
zh: 第二个提案比第一个好得多。

content: This method is no ___ effective than the old one.
explanation: no more effective than 意为「并不比……更有效」。
zh: 这个方法并不比旧方法更有效。

content: He is ___ the most qualified candidate.
explanation: by far 与最高级连用，表示「显然」。
zh: 他显然是最合格的人选。

content: The results were ___ better than anticipated.
explanation: 副词 substantially 修饰比较级 better。
zh: 结果比预期好得多。

content: The issue is ___ more complex than it first appeared.
explanation: 副词 considerably 修饰比较级。
zh: 这个问题比初看时复杂得多。

content: Few things are ___ important than trust.
explanation: few + 比较级 表示「很少有比……更……的」。
zh: 很少有比信任更重要的东西。

content: This is ___ the best solution available.
explanation: far and away 与最高级连用，意为「远远地」。
zh: 这无疑是目前最好的方案。

content: Her analysis was ___ more thorough than mine.
explanation: 副词 infinitely 修饰比较级。
zh: 她的分析比我的周密得多。

content: The two are ___ alike than they appear.
explanation: more alike than 表示「比看起来更像」。
zh: 两者比表面上更像。

content: It was raining; ___ , we went out.
explanation: however 表示转折。
zh: 当时在下雨；然而我们还是出去了。

content: He was tired; ___ , he kept working.
explanation: nevertheless 表示让步转折。
zh: 他累了；尽管如此，他还是继续工作。

content: She studied hard; ___ , she passed.
explanation: therefore 表示因果关系。
zh: 她学习很努力，因此通过了。

content: ___ , I'd like to thank everyone.
explanation: finally 用于引出最后一点。
zh: 最后，我想感谢所有人。

content: First, we plan; ___ , we act.
explanation: then 表示顺序上的接着。
zh: 我们先计划，然后再行动。

content: ___ , let me explain the background.
explanation: First of all 用于引出第一点。
zh: 首先，让我说明一下背景。

content: ___ the cost, the plan is impractical.
explanation: apart from 意为「除……之外」。
zh: 除了成本之外，这个计划也不切实际。

content: ___ , the results were encouraging.
explanation: on the whole 意为「总的来说」。
zh: 总的来说，结果令人鼓舞。

content: He failed; ___ , he learned a lot.
explanation: however 表示转折。
zh: 他失败了，不过学到了很多。

content: ___ , we should consider the alternatives.
explanation: furthermore 表示递进。
zh: 此外，我们还应该考虑其他选择。

content: ___ , the evidence is inconclusive.
explanation: in short 意为「简而言之」。
zh: 简而言之，证据不足以定论。

content: The plan failed; ___ , we lost money.
explanation: consequently 表示结果。
zh: 计划失败了，结果我们赔了钱。

content: ___ , there is no easy solution.
explanation: 句首用副词 Unfortunately。
zh: 遗憾的是，没有简单的解决办法。

content: ___ , the two issues are unrelated.
explanation: on the contrary 意为「恰恰相反」。
zh: 恰恰相反，这两个问题互不相关。

content: ___ , let me summarise the main points.
explanation: to conclude 用于引出结论。
zh: 最后，让我总结一下要点。

content: ___ , the policy has had unintended effects.
explanation: arguably 意为「可以说」，用于缓和论断。
zh: 可以说，这项政策产生了意料之外的后果。

content: The findings are limited; ___ , they are useful.
explanation: nevertheless 表示让步转折。
zh: 这些发现有其局限，尽管如此仍有用。

content: ___ , the two theories are incompatible.
explanation: in essence 意为「本质上」。
zh: 本质上，这两种理论互不相容。

content: ___ , the sample was too small.
explanation: admittedly 意为「诚然、无可否认」。
zh: 诚然，样本量太小。

content: ___ , the results support the hypothesis.
explanation: taken together 意为「综合来看」。
zh: 综合来看，结果支持这一假设。

content: ___ , this is a matter of principle.
explanation: ultimately 意为「归根结底」。
zh: 归根结底，这是原则问题。

content: ___ , the project was a qualified success.
explanation: all in all 意为「总的来说」。
zh: 总的来说，这个项目算是成功的。

content: ___ , no such evidence has emerged.
explanation: to date 意为「迄今为止」。
zh: 迄今为止，尚未出现这样的证据。

content: ___ , the argument rests on shaky assumptions.
explanation: in effect 意为「实际上」。
zh: 实际上，这个论证建立在不可靠的假设上。

content: ___ , the evidence points the other way.
explanation: if anything 意为「要说有什么不同的话」。
zh: 要说有什么不同的话，证据指向相反方向。

content: ___ , the reforms were half-hearted.
explanation: by and large 意为「大体上」。
zh: 大体上，这些改革是三心二意的。

content: ___ , the two are not mutually exclusive.
explanation: that said 意为「话虽如此」。
zh: 话虽如此，两者并不互斥。

content: ___ , the decision was inevitable.
explanation: with hindsight 意为「事后看来」。
zh: 事后看来，这个决定是不可避免的。

content: ___ , the report avoids the central question.
explanation: significantly 在此作句子副词，意为「值得注意的是」。
zh: 值得注意的是，报告回避了核心问题。

content: ___ , the proposal is worth pursuing.
explanation: on balance 意为「权衡之后」。
zh: 权衡之后，这个提案值得推进。

content: I like tea ___ coffee.
explanation: and 表示并列。
zh: 我喜欢茶和咖啡。

content: He is tired, ___ he keeps working.
explanation: but 表示转折。
zh: 他累了，但还在继续工作。

content: It was late, ___ we went home.
explanation: so 表示结果。
zh: 天晚了，所以我们回家了。

content: Would you like tea ___ coffee?
explanation: or 表示选择。
zh: 你想要茶还是咖啡？

content: ___ he is young, he is very capable.
explanation: although 引导让步状语从句。
zh: 虽然他年轻，但很有能力。

content: ___ it was raining, we stayed inside.
explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
zh: 因为下雨，我们待在里面。

content: Both Tom ___ Jerry came.
explanation: both... and... 是固定搭配。
zh: 汤姆和杰里都来了。

content: Either you ___ I must go.
explanation: either... or... 是固定搭配。
zh: 要么你去，要么我去。

content: Neither he ___ his brother came.
explanation: neither... nor... 是固定搭配。
zh: 他和他的哥哥都没来。

content: He was tired, ___ he didn't stop.
explanation: but 表示转折。
zh: 他累了，但没有停下来。

content: ___ he had finished, he left.
explanation: after 引导时间状语从句。
zh: 他完成后就离开了。

content: We waited ___ he arrived.
explanation: until 引导时间状语从句，表示「直到」。
zh: 我们一直等到他来。

content: ___ he was reading, she was cooking.
explanation: while 引导的从句表示持续动作。
zh: 他看书的时候她在做饭。

content: He works hard ___ he wants to succeed.
explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
zh: 他努力工作是因为他想成功。

content: ___ you study, you will fail.
explanation: unless 意为「除非」。
zh: 除非你学习，否则你会不及格。

content: He is not only clever ___ also hard-working.
explanation: not only... but also... 是固定搭配。
zh: 他不仅聪明，而且勤奋。

content: ___ hard he tried, he couldn't win.
explanation: however + 副词，表示「无论多么」。
zh: 无论他多努力，都赢不了。

content: We'll go ___ the weather is good.
explanation: as long as 意为「只要」。
zh: 只要天气好我们就去。

content: ___ it rains, we'll cancel.
explanation: in case 后接从句。
zh: 万一下雨，我们就取消。

content: He kept silent ___ he was angry.
explanation: even though 意为「即使、尽管」，语气强于 though。
zh: 尽管他很生气，他还是保持沉默。

content: ___ he arrived, we started eating.
explanation: as soon as 意为「一……就……」。
zh: 他一到我们就开始吃饭。

content: Both the manager ___ the staff agreed.
explanation: both... and... 是固定搭配。
zh: 经理和员工都同意了。

content: ___ the cost nor the time was acceptable.
explanation: neither... nor... 是固定搭配。
zh: 成本和时间都不可接受。

content: He was late, ___ he missed the start.
explanation: so 表示结果。
zh: 他迟到了，所以错过了开头。

content: ___ she was tired, she finished the work.
explanation: although 引导让步状语从句。
zh: 尽管累了，她还是完成了工作。

content: ___ the difficulties, the project succeeded.
explanation: notwithstanding 是正式介词，意为「尽管」。
zh: 尽管有困难，项目还是成功了。

content: He resigned ___ he was offered a better post.
explanation: because 引导原因状语从句。
zh: 他辞职了，因为有人给了他更好的职位。

content: ___ the evidence, the case was dismissed.
explanation: given 作介词，意为「考虑到」。
zh: 考虑到证据情况，案件被驳回。

content: ___ that the funding is secured, we can proceed.
explanation: provided that 意为「只要」。
zh: 只要资金到位，我们就可以推进。

content: He acted ___ he owned the place.
explanation: as if 意为「好像」。
zh: 他的举止好像他是这儿的主人。

content: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
explanation: 先行词指人，作从句主语用 who。
zh: 住在隔壁的那个男人是医生。

content: The book ___ I bought is interesting.
explanation: 先行词指物，用 which。
zh: 我买的那本书很有趣。

content: This is the girl ___ father is a pilot.
explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
zh: 这就是那个父亲是飞行员的女孩。

content: The house ___ we live in is old.
explanation: 先行词指物，用 which。
zh: 我们住的房子很旧。

content: I know a man ___ can help you.
explanation: 先行词指人，作主语用 who。
zh: 我认识一个能帮你的人。

content: The film ___ we saw was boring.
explanation: 先行词指物，that 与 which 均可。
zh: 我们看的那部电影很无聊。

content: This is the place ___ we met.
explanation: 先行词是地点且从句缺状语，用 where。
zh: 这就是我们相遇的地方。

content: The reason ___ he left is unknown.
explanation: 先行词 reason 后接关系副词 why。
zh: 他离开的原因不明。

content: The day ___ we met was sunny.
explanation: 先行词是时间，用关系副词 when。
zh: 我们相遇那天是晴天。

content: He is the person ___ I spoke to.
explanation: 关系代词作介词宾语，指人用 whom。
zh: 他就是我交谈过的那个人。

content: All ___ glitters is not gold.
explanation: 先行词为 all 时关系代词只能用 that。
zh: 闪光的不都是金子。

content: This is the best film ___ I have seen.
explanation: 先行词被最高级修饰时用 that。
zh: 这是我看过最好的电影。

content: The only thing ___ matters is health.
explanation: 先行词被 only 修饰时用 that。
zh: 唯一重要的是健康。

content: She has two brothers, ___ are doctors.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that，指人用 who。
zh: 她有两个哥哥，都是医生。

content: The car, ___ was stolen, has been found.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物用 which。
zh: 那辆被偷的车已经找到了。

content: Everything ___ he said was true.
explanation: 先行词为 everything 时用 that。
zh: 他说的一切都是真的。

content: The woman ___ car was stolen called the police.
explanation: 表示所属关系用 whose。
zh: 车被偷的那个女人报了警。

content: I don't know the reason ___ she refused.
explanation: 先行词 reason 后用 why。
zh: 我不知道她拒绝的原因。

content: There were no seats ___ were free.
explanation: 先行词被 no 修饰时用 that。
zh: 没有空着的座位。

content: He lives in a town ___ is near the coast.
explanation: 从句缺主语，用关系代词 which。
zh: 他住在一个靠近海岸的镇上。

content: The proposal, ___ was submitted last week, was rejected.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句不用 that。
zh: 上周提交的那份提案被否决了。

content: He is the only one ___ can solve it.
explanation: 先行词被 the only one 修饰时用 that。
zh: 他是唯一能解决它的人。

content: The extent ___ the policy worked is debated.
explanation: the extent to which 是固定搭配。
zh: 该政策起效的程度有争议。

content: She spoke to the manager, ___ was very helpful.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句指人用 who。
zh: 她和经理谈过，经理很帮忙。

content: The point ___ I want to make is simple.
explanation: 先行词 the point 在从句中作 make 的宾语，可用 that 或 which。
zh: 我想说的这一点很简单。

content: We regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
explanation: 正式函件中 regret to inform 是惯用表达。
zh: 很遗憾通知您，您的申请未获通过。

content: ___ to your enquiry of 3 May, we can confirm the details.
explanation: further to 是正式商务函件的开头用语，意为「关于」。
zh: 关于您 5 月 3 日的询问，我们可以确认相关细节。

content: Please find ___ the requested documents.
explanation: please find enclosed 是正式函件用语。
zh: 随函附上您所需的文件。

content: I am writing with ___ to your recent advertisement.
explanation: with regard to 是正式用语，意为「关于」。
zh: 我写信是想咨询您最近的广告。

content: Should you require ___ information, please contact us.
explanation: further information 意为「更多信息」，正式用语。
zh: 如需更多信息，请联系我们。

content: We would be grateful ___ you could confirm by Friday.
explanation: we would be grateful if 是正式请求用语。
zh: 如果您能在周五前确认，我们将不胜感激。

content: I look forward to ___ from you at your earliest convenience.
explanation: look forward to 后接动名词，是正式函件常用结束语。
zh: 期待您尽早回复。

content: The report ___ that immediate action be taken.
explanation: 主句主语单数，用 recommends；后接虚拟语气 be taken。
zh: 报告建议立即采取行动。

content: ___ is hereby given that the meeting is postponed.
explanation: notice is hereby given 是正式公告用语。
zh: 特此通知，会议延期。

content: The parties ___ agree to the terms set out below.
explanation: hereby 是法律文书用语，意为「特此」。
zh: 双方特此同意下列条款。

content: Any breach of this clause shall ___ the contract void.
explanation: shall 后接动词原形，render sth void 意为「使……无效」。
zh: 违反本条款将使合同失效。

content: The foregoing ___ notwithstanding, the clause stands.
explanation: the foregoing provisions 意为「上述条款」，法律用语。
zh: 尽管有上述条款，本条款仍然有效。

content: We ___ your prompt attention to this matter.
explanation: 主语 We 用动词原形 request，正式用语。
zh: 我们请您尽快处理此事。

content: I should be ___ if you would send the details.
explanation: I should be grateful if... 是正式请求用语。
zh: 如蒙您告知详情，我将不胜感激。

content: The findings ___ with the conclusions of earlier studies.
explanation: 主语 the findings 为复数，用动词原形 accord；accord with 意为「与……一致」。
zh: 这些发现与早先研究的结论一致。

content: Please ___ us of any change of address.
explanation: notify sb of sth 是正式用语，意为「通知某人某事」。
zh: 地址如有变更请通知我们。

content: This agreement ___ into force upon signature.
explanation: 主语 This agreement 单数，用 enters。
zh: 本协议自签署之日起生效。

content: ___ accordance with your instructions, we have processed the order.
explanation: in accordance with 是正式用语，意为「依照」。
zh: 依照您的指示，我们已处理订单。

content: We ___ to inform you of a change to our schedule.
explanation: 主语 We 用 write；we write to inform you 是正式函件开头。
zh: 我们致函通知您日程的变动。

content: The aforementioned documents ___ attached for your reference.
explanation: 主语 documents 复数，用 are。
zh: 上述文件随附供您参考。
